field_descriptions.associated_disease: Disease associated to this BioChemEntity. Such disease can be a MedicalCondition or a URL. If you want to add an evidence supporting the association, please use PropertyValue.
field_descriptions.bio_chem_interaction: A BioChemEntity that is known to interact with this item.
field_descriptions.bio_chem_similarity: A similar BioChemEntity, e.g., obtained by fingerprint similarity algorithms.
field_descriptions.biological_role: A role played by the BioChemEntity within a biological context.
field_descriptions.funding: A [[Grant]] that directly or indirectly provide funding or sponsorship for this item. See also [[ownershipFundingInfo]].
field_descriptions.has_bio_chem_entity_part: Indicates a BioChemEntity that (in some sense) has this BioChemEntity as a part.
field_descriptions.has_molecular_function: Molecular function performed by this BioChemEntity; please use PropertyValue if you want to include any evidence.
field_descriptions.has_representation: A common representation such as a protein sequence or chemical structure for this entity. For images use schema.org/image.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.is_encoded_by_bio_chem_entity: Another BioChemEntity encoding by this one.
field_descriptions.is_involved_in_biological_process: Biological process this BioChemEntity is involved in; please use PropertyValue if you want to include any evidence.
field_descriptions.is_located_in_subcellular_location: Subcellular location where this BioChemEntity is located; please use PropertyValue if you want to include any evidence.
field_descriptions.is_part_of_bio_chem_entity: Indicates a BioChemEntity that is (in some sense) a part of this BioChemEntity.
field_descriptions.taxonomic_range: The taxonomic grouping of the organism that expresses, encodes, or in some way related to the BioChemEntity.
